name: combat-writing-crew
description: The Combat Writing add-on: a local MCP server that sends each seat's packet to other companies' models on your own API keys, so the crew is the fresh reader plus one seat per outside model you hold a key for. One free Groq key seats two: a crew of three. Each key goes only to its own provider, never to Learning Producers, and the add-on writes no key to any file. A key reaches it from two places and no other: the masked prompt first, then the owner-only key file you write by hand in your home folder (~/.combat-writing/keys), the one that survives a host update. An outside seat's second overrun of the word cap is cut at the cap with its rating kept and marked in the record. Built for Claude Code: a local MCP server is ignored in chat on claude.ai and loads in the desktop app only on your own computer.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API key
groq_api_key.description: Seats Groq's free models (OpenAI's open-weight line and Alibaba's Qwen line). Sent only to api.groq.com. Leave empty to use a GROQ_API_KEY=... line in your owner-only ~/.combat-writing/keys file instead, or to leave the seats out.

xai_api_key.title: xAI API key
xai_api_key.description: Seats xAI's Grok line. Sent only to api.x.ai. Leave empty to use a XAI_API_KEY=... line in your owner-only ~/.combat-writing/keys file instead, or to leave the seat out.

perplexity_api_key.title: Perplexity API key
perplexity_api_key.description: Seats Perplexity's Sonar line. Sent only to api.perplexity.ai. Leave empty to use a PERPLEXITY_API_KEY=... line in your owner-only ~/.combat-writing/keys file instead, or to leave the seat out.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Seats OpenAI's GPT line. Sent only to api.openai.com. Leave empty to use a OPENAI_API_KEY=... line in your owner-only ~/.combat-writing/keys file instead, or to leave the seat out.

mistral_api_key.title: Mistral API key
mistral_api_key.description: Seats Mistral's large line. Sent only to api.mistral.ai. Leave empty to use a MISTRAL_API_KEY=... line in your owner-only ~/.combat-writing/keys file instead, or to leave the seat out.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Seats Google's Gemini line through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Sent only to generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Leave empty to use a GEMINI_API_KEY=... line in your owner-only ~/.combat-writing/keys file instead, or to leave the seat out.

ollama_model.title: Ollama model (local, optional)
ollama_model.description: The name of a model your local Ollama serves, such as the one you pulled. Empty leaves the Ollama seat off. The add-on sends this seat's packet to localhost only. What your Ollama does with it is Ollama's.
